PhD Seminar in Digital Economics

Presenting and discussing doctoral research in digital economics.

SeminarOrganisers and team

Once a month, PhD students get together for two or three presentations: a paper, an idea for a paper, or a thesis project. Afterwards, we continue the conversation over a beer or a drink with fellow PhD students.

Depending on the session, the seminar takes place at Campus Condorcet, at CRED, Université Paris Assas, in the 15th arrondissement of Paris, or at IMT Business School in Évry. We thank these institutions for hosting us.
